adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the constructed `evt: CalendarEvent` omits any `team` property (it sets `organizer`, `attendees`, `destinationCalendar`, etc., but no `team`). Yet `sendAddGuestsEmails` (added in `packages/emails/email-manager.ts`) calls `formatCalEvent(calEvent)` and then conditionally iterates `calendarEvent.team?.members` to send `OrganizerAddGuestsEmail` to team members. With no `team` on `evt`, `calendarEvent.team` will be absent unless `formatCalEvent` can infer it from other fields (not shown in the diff). Based on the diff alone, the team-member notification branch will never run for this new pathway, so co-hosts/team members won't receive the organizer email as intended.
